narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>That is quick. Add one to the top and to the bottom, and one half becomes two thirds.
<bookmark mark='longer'/>Shade two thirds of the same whole. It reaches past the middle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Two thirds is more than one half, so adding one gives a different amount.
